About the Role
In this role, you will play a critical part in shaping the future of artificial intelligence and media analysis.
Your main responsibility will be to review short-form video media and classify the language present in both spoken audio and on-screen text. By validating content within your native locale, you will generate high-quality "ground truth" data. 
Job Type: Freelance
Location: Brazil (work from home)
Work Schedule: Part-time - 10+ hours per week. Flexible - work whenever you want.
Start Date: Immediately
Duration: TBC
Rate: 6 USD per hour
What You’ll Do
Media Evaluation: Watch and analyze short-form video clips to identify all languages present.
Locale Validation: Verify and validate that the media content aligns with your specific target locale (e.g., an annotator based in Germany validating that the media is authentic to the Bengali [Bangladesh] linguistic and cultural context).
Data Labeling: Generate highly accurate ground truth labels using our internal classification tools according to strict project guidelines.
Quality Assurance: Ensure high data quality and consistency to meet the standards required for training automated machine learning models.
What we’re looking for:
Must be currently living in Brazil.
Native-level written and spoken fluency in Portuguese.
Access to a reliable, high-speed internet connection and a secure personal computer/laptop.
Ability to strictly follow detailed photography and data entry guidelines.
(Preferred but not required) Previous experience in data annotation, content moderation, translation, transcription, or linguistic QA is a strong asset.

Are you an experienced Portuguese voice actor eager to shape the future of AI? Large-scale language models and speech technologies are evolving rapidly, moving beyond simple interactions into expressive, human-like communication. With high-quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can deliver more natural, accurate, and engaging voice experiences across education, entertainment, accessibility, and beyond. That training data begins with you—your voice expertise will help power the next generation of AI.

 We’re looking for a highly skilled Portuguese voice acting professional who can bring nuance, clarity, and authenticity to training data. You’ll work with cutting-edge AI tools, record and evaluate Portuguese speech samples, and provide expert feedback on pronunciation, tone, pacing, and emotional expression to strengthen voice models.

 On a typical day, you will record scripted material, assess AI-generated outputs for linguistic accuracy and naturalness, annotate errors, and collaborate with our team to refine prompts, evaluation methods, and voice design guidelines.

 Fluency in Portuguese is required, along with demonstrated experience in professional voice acting, dubbing, narration, or related performance work. Experience in training, coaching, or linguistic annotation is a plus. Clear communication skills and attention to detail are essential. A high-quality recording setup—including a reliable microphone and a quiet environment—is required.

 Ready to channel your Portuguese voice expertise into building the AI voices of tomorrow? Apply today and help shape the model that will speak to millions around the world.

 We offer a pay range of $6 to $65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer, high-quality microphone and recording setup, and stable internet connection; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.

# Portuguese Language Expert (AI Training)

## About the Role

We're looking for Portuguese language experts to help evaluate and improve AI systems trained on Portuguese-language content. Your linguistic insight will directly shape how AI understands, generates, and communicates in Portuguese — making a real impact on one of the world's most widely spoken languages.

- **Organization**: Alignerr
- **Type**: Hourly Contract
- **Location**: Remote
- **Commitment**: 10–40 hours/week

## What You'll Do

* Review AI-generated Portuguese translations and original content for accuracy and naturalness
* Identify mistranslations, unnatural phrasing, register mismatches, or cultural issues
* Suggest improvements for clear, idiomatic, and culturally appropriate Portuguese
* Provide structured feedback on linguistic and cultural quality
* Work independently and asynchronously on your own schedule

## Who You Are

* Native or near-native fluency in Portuguese
* Strong written communication skills in both Portuguese and English
* Solid command of contemporary Portuguese usage across different contexts
* Comfortable evaluating written language quality at scale
* Attention to detail and consistency
* No prior AI experience required

## Nice to Have

* Experience in translation, localization, or editing
* Familiarity with AI or language evaluation workflows
* Knowledge of regional Portuguese variations (Brazilian, European, etc.)

## Why Join Us

* Work on cutting-edge AI projects with top research labs
* Fully remote and flexible — work on your own schedule
* Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and global collaboration
* Contribute to meaningful work that improves AI for Portuguese speakers worldwide
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension
